title: AiHarness terminal keybindings
description: Data-only global or explicitly selected configuration. Runtime validation additionally enforces UTF-8 byte ceilings, canonical chord uniqueness, one non-modifier per chord, unique IDs and reserved Escape (including the Node alt+escape decoder alias)/Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D ownership. Loading never executes an action.

keys.description: One chord, either components such as [ctrl,h] or joined strings such as [ctrl+h]. Case-insensitive control/option/return/esc aliases are accepted; callbacks and code are never allowed.

action.description: Explicit host action ID. If omitted, id is used. Unknown IDs remain unavailable until the host explicitly registers them. Legacy saved-default IDs are retained without inventing action authority.

preventDefault.description: False deliberately allows the native editor event after the configured action, potentially producing both effects. Reserved safety keys keep native ownership.
